lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Источник, спутники и внешний GNSS
value.meaning: Status icon/satellites describe displayed Location; external HUD separately describes selected receiver/session/fix quality. Connected does not equal usable fix.
value.value_origin: Location.provider/extras -> tv_source; external session+GnssFix -> fillGnssHud -> quality/detail
value.units: Satellite count, HDOP, horizontal accuracy cm below1m else metres;4fix/5float/2DGPS/other auto.
updates: Location, external fix and external status callbacks.
actions: Select system/external; connect or lose receiver fix.
conditions: HUD hidden unless external input; no-device, connecting and no-fix are distinct branches.
value.saved_state: Input choice persists upstream; transient HUD is rebuilt from session state.
expectations: Connecting/no-fix must not display old positive fix quality; system input hides external HUD.
Counterexample: satellite count is not project object count and cannot certify recorder readiness.
unknowns: Runtime NOT_RUN: no GUI, device, emulator, build or APK resource merge acceptance in this task.
